result.summary: Found two minor visual issues related to text truncation and potentially incorrect promo data.

issues.description: The restaurant label 'Trattoria Piccolo' is abruptly truncated without an ellipsis.
issues.suggestion: Implement proper text-overflow handling with an ellipsis to denote truncation.

issues.description: The pizza offer displays a '-100%' badge, which appears to be mock or faulty placeholder data.
issues.suggestion: Validate and constrain promotion percentage values before rendering them on the UI.
